memory.config.section: Memory automation (protected; no AI may change it): extraction.mode turns on candidates from accepted work (off, shadow records only, live writes candidates); verification.mode turns on the independent evaluator (off, shadow seals its records and verifies nothing, on verifies); context.mode lets verified entries reach worker prompts at Run admission (off, shadow seals what would be sent and sends nothing, on sends); automation narrows the Core bounds and WorkClass rows.
memory.withheld: {count} more entries are hidden: they come from work you may not read or a work target you may not use.
memory.alert.extractionBound: Memory extraction reached a bound in scope {scope}: {count} candidates were not written in this window (nothing was shortened).
memory.alert.screening: Memory extraction refused {count} candidates in scope {scope}: they held a secret or hidden characters.
error.MEMORY_ENTRY_WITHHELD: This memory entry comes from work you may not read; it is not shown.
error.MEMORY_PURGED_CONTENT: This content was purged from memory and cannot be proposed again.
error.MEMORY_EXTRACTION_BOUND: A memory extraction bound was reached; the candidate was not written.
error.MEMORY_CANDIDATE_SECRET: The memory candidate holds a secret and was refused.
error.MEMORY_CANDIDATE_QUARANTINED: The memory candidate holds hidden characters and was refused.
error.MEMORY_DISTILLER_REQUIRED: Only the memory distiller of this installation writes system candidates.
error.MEMORY_AUTOMATION_INVALID: The memory automation settings are invalid or try to widen a Core bound; only narrowing is allowed.
memory.alert.evaluationDailyCap: The memory evaluator reached its daily call limit in scope {scope}; candidates stay candidates until tomorrow.
memory.alert.spendCap: The memory evaluator stopped in scope {scope}: the day's spend limit was reached or a call's cost is not settled yet; candidates stay candidates.
memory.alert.evaluatorBreaker: The memory evaluator stopped in scope {scope}: too many answers today could not be read; candidates stay candidates.
memory.alert.contestBound: The memory evaluator reached its daily contest limit in scope {scope}; further conflicts are not withdrawn from model context today.
memory.view.noIndependentEvaluator: No independent evaluator is available in this scope: candidates stay candidates until a person verifies them.
memory.view.evaluator.price.perToken: catalog price {input} in / {output} out per million tokens (as of {asOf}); at most {calls} calls a day of up to {tokens} answer tokens, so answers cost at most {ceiling} a day
memory.view.evaluator.independence: An entry is evaluated only by a model of another maker than the one that did the work; the candidate text is sent to that model's provider.
memory.view.evaluator.unavailable: The memory evaluator could not be read; candidates stay candidates.
error.MEMORY_EVALUATION_NOT_INDEPENDENT: The evaluation is not independent of the models that did the work, so it cannot verify this memory entry.
error.MEMORY_EVALUATION_MAKER_UNKNOWN: The maker of a model behind this memory entry is not known, so independence cannot be shown and the entry stays a candidate.
error.MEMORY_EVALUATOR_REQUIRED: Only this installation's memory evaluator applies its own evaluation; no other AI verifies memory.
error.MEMORY_CONTEXT_HELD: The Run was not admitted: its worker memory could not be read ({reason}). Nothing was started.
memory.held.next.MEMORY_CONTEXT_HELD: Run deckent doctor and repair the memory store, or have a person set memoryAutomation.context.mode to off at their own terminal; then create the Run again.
run.warning.MEMORY_CONTEXT_WITHHELD.poli: Warning: workers in this Run get no project memory: you may not read this scope's memory.
run.warning.MEMORY_CONTEXT_WITHHELD.sour: Warning: task {taskId}: {count} memory entries were left out of the worker prompt; they come from work you may not read or a work target you may not use.
run.warning.MEMORY_CONTEXT_WITHHELD.budg: Warning: task {taskId}: the worker prompt had no room for project memory, so the worker runs without it.
run.warning.MEMORY_CONTEXT_WITHHELD.cont: Warning: workers in this Run get no project memory: more memory contests are open than can be checked; resolve them with deckent memory review.
inspect.context.memory: Memory: {value} (verified entries, sent as data; they grant no permission)
error.BRAIN_MEMORY_CONTEXT_HELD: Planning was refused: the project memory could not be read ({reason}). No model was called and no proposal was recorded.
memory.held.next.BRAIN_MEMORY_CONTEXT_HE: Run deckent doctor and repair the memory store, or have a person set memoryAutomation.context.mode to off at their own terminal; then ask for the plan again.
brain.memory.sent: Memory: {count} verified entries went to planning as data; they grant no permission.
brain.memory.shadow: Memory (shadow): {count} verified entries would have gone to planning; nothing was sent.
brain.memory.omitted: Memory: {count} more entries were left out by the planning size limits.
brain.memory.withheld.sources: Memory: {count} entries were hidden from planning: they come from work you may not read or a work target you may not use.
brain.memory.withheld.policy: Memory: planning got no project memory: you may not read this scope's memory.
brain.memory.withheld.contests: Memory: planning got no project memory: more memory contests are open than can be checked; resolve them with deckent memory review.
brain.memory.withheld.template: Memory: the selected planning template does not take project memory, so none was read or sent.
